headline: Committee recommends adopting Resolution 26-147 to settle lawsuit over Kulamalu Park fall

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.voteItem: Motion to recommend adoption of Resolution 26-147, including any non-substantive revisions
meeting.summary: The committee voted 7-0 to recommend adopting Resolution 26-147, which would approve settling a lawsuit over a March 8, 2024 fall at Kulamalu Park, after a closed-door session with its lawyers. The chair said written testimony will continue to be accepted.
meeting.recap: The committee took up Resolution 26-147, which would approve settling a lawsuit against the county.[[0:03:00]] A deputy corporation counsel (a county lawyer) said the lawsuit comes from an incident on March 8, 2024, at Kulamalu Park.[[0:04:06]] She said the woman was carrying her granddaughter down the stairs and reached for a railing that was not there.[[0:04:12]] The woman claims injuries including a fractured hip.[[0:04:30]] The Parks director said his department agrees with the county lawyers' proposal.[[0:05:06]] One caller testified and asked the county to spend less money taking people to court.[[0:07:58]] He said no repairs have been made to the stairs since the accident.[[0:11:48]] He said the park is used mainly for Pop Warner football.[[0:12:33]] The committee voted 7-0 to go into executive session (a closed-door discussion) with its lawyers.[[0:13:39]] A legislative attorney said the closed session covered the case's strengths and weaknesses, the damages claimed, and settlement efforts.[[0:16:20]] The committee voted 7-0 to recommend adopting Resolution 26-147.[[0:16:57]]
decided: The committee voted 7-0 to recommend adoption of Resolution 26-147, which would approve the lawsuit settlement.
meeting.next: The chair said written testimony will continue to be accepted.
